properties.name: Roman Empire
properties.note: For 1204–1205, the earliest available Nicaean outline (1206–1209) is used as an approximation.

source: Cliopatria / Seshat Global History Databank, Bennett et al. (2025)
changes: Roman territories dissolved into one Roman Empire outline per date interval; the Nicaean imperial lineage is included from 1204. Original Nicaean snapshots continue through 1278 under the unified label. Earliest 1206 outline approximates 1204–1205; the 1260 restored-capital snapshot starts in 1261, with the previous outline retained through 1260. Aegean shores reconciled with Natural Earth 1:10m geography. Omitted small-island control is approximated from the dated held-island cluster and proximity, with a tighter neighbourhood from 1204; other successor states are excluded. Topology-preserving simplification at 0.003 degrees, geometry cleaned on the TopoJSON grid at one million quantization steps. No interpolation across other missing periods.
